content.text: Clear evidence: feature flag `monthly-spend-feature` was toggled on, and error rate rose as the flag rollout percentage increased (41 evaluations "on" at 21:43, then 100% "on" at 21:44), directly correlating with ZeroDivisionError in spend_summary.py:47. hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on (partial rollout at 21:43, full at 21:44), and the new code path it enables throws a ZeroDivisionError in spend_summary.py:47, causing the error rate to jump from baseline (~1%) to 27-34%. Latency percentiles stayed flat throughout, consistent with a flag-driven error rather than a code/resource/traffic issue.
